description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary leader to make a significant impact on patient care and facility success.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. We are looking for a leader committed to excellence and continuous improvement. This role offers a competitive salary for the right candidate.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Proven leadership experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Demonstrated ability to manage financial, operational, and clinical aspects of a facility.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated Part-time Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in beautiful St. Petersburg, FL. This role offers a consistent 12-hour PM shift, from 7 PM to 7 AM, providing essential care in a supportive environment. If you are passionate about patient care and looking for an immediate opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

This facility is a welcoming 55-59 bed center, currently serving a census of 43 residents. It boasts a convenient location on a main street with abundant shopping nearby, nestled in a nice neighborhood, and is just 15 minutes from the beach. The center also features two inviting courtyards, offering a pleasant atmosphere for both residents and staff. Join a team committed to excellence and make a significant impact on the lives of residents.
requirements: Active LPN license in the state of Florida
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting preferred
Ability to work 12-hour PM shifts (7 PM - 7 AM)
Strong clinical assessment and documentation skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $30.00 - $35.00 per hour, with an additional $2.00 per hour shift differential for PM shifts.
